construction: 126 parts in 30 steps plus ten children. Steps 3–10: Technic bricks, locking hinge arms, side-stud bricks, a ball joint and sockets. Step 11: two `Side` children, each a 4×1 double curved slope on a 1×4 plate, turned ±X onto 1×1 side-stud bricks; they form the lime flank stripes. Steps 22–29: body, tail, legs and hands as children. The rear leg is turned studs-sideways and swung 30° on a locking hinge; the front leg is turned 90° about X (studs −Z); the hands are at odd angles. Step 30: the `Head` child; each turret eye is a 2×2 double convex 45° slope turned ±X, with an eye-pattern round tile.
interfaces: Stud directions: 126 parts, 82 up, 10 each +X, −X and −Z, 14 angled.
lesson: Turret eyes from sideways convex slopes; limbs as rotated children on hinges and ball joints.
parent_context: The whole model; `31031 - Main.ldr` places it with the identity matrix.
reuse_notes: Build limbs and eyes as children and turn them at the joint; side stripes go on side-stud bricks.
